title: Dominic and the Tryouts
author: Kestrel Yarrow
blurb: Noor Dravenmoor, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
